market_view: SA steadied: the JSE All Share was flat on the week (+0.1% to 108,525) and the rand firmed 0.8% to R16.51/$, with the SA 10-year easing to 8.96% while the repo rate holds at 7.25% after September's hike. US shares rose (S&P 500 +1.2%, Nasdaq +0.6%) with the 10-year a little lower at 5.24%, while Brent climbed 2.4% to $104.7 and gold (+1.3%) and copper (+2.2%) firmed, platinum and iron ore flat to softer. Yields above 5% still weigh on long-duration tech, and US CPI (14 Oct) and the 28 Oct FOMC are the next tests.
